notes: Corrects how shields interact with poison, burn and shock. The sim had the rule inverted and was over-punishing shields, so poison was heavily overrated against shield boards. Per the batodex wiki, status damage is REDUCED against shields (15% since 0.8.5) - a shield now soaks more than its face value against status. The counter-read also stops lumping heal walls and shield walls together: a ramp beats healing, direct damage beats shields.
